name: KIC 12008916
class_label_origin: published source; not inferred solely from this image
observable_signature: Small stochastic oscillations; power spread across many modes.

photometry.processing: Kepler PDCSAP flux; SAP_QUALITY == 0; each downloaded segment normalized separately by its median; see embedded samples for exact selected samples; divided by running median with 25 retained samples (~0.5 d; ignores gaps), nearest edge handling; error divided by same trend, trend uncertainty omitted. Slow variability is suppressed; amplitudes depend on filter.
photometry.nominal_cadence_note: FITS TIMEDEL; exposure/integration and gaps may differ

measured_features.relative_flux_reference: median of retained observed flux; magnitude conversion = 10**(-0.4*(mag-median(mag)))
measured_features.period_origin: No single coherent period assigned to stochastic oscillations

periodogram.interpretation: descriptive only; sampling aliases, harmonics and blended sources can dominate; not a calibrated detection

source.credit: NASA Kepler / MAST; source authors linked below

classification_limit: Match morphology, cadence, baseline and bandpass before comparison. One example is not a calibrated classifier; return a candidate class and alternatives. No mass, radius, temperature, age, distance or composition is inferred here.

provenance.samples_sha256_definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(samples, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=False)

feature_definitions.scope: Computed from retained samples after the stated processing; not intrinsic stellar parameters or class limits. Formal feature uncertainties were not calculated.
feature_definitions.percentiles: numpy.quantile, linear interpolation; robust amplitude = p99 minus p01; not a fitted transit depth
feature_definitions.successive_difference_variance_ratio: mean((f[i+1]-f[i])**2)/var(f); includes pairs across gaps; sampling-dependent
feature_definitions.fourier: 4-harmonic weighted least squares; amplitude ratios and phase differences are descriptive; no prewhitening; not appropriate as physical mode identification
feature_definitions.lomb_scargle: astropy.timeseries.LombScargle(t,f,error), floating mean, one sinusoid, standard normalization; no false-alarm calibration; selected-grid maximum may be an alias or harmonic
feature_definitions.display: Time series uses retained points; phase plot uses arbitrary zero at first sample and 80 equal phase bins with unweighted median. Solar-like example instead shows a time zoom and frequency-band detail.
